verdict.rationale: Event-driven rules are a fair axis for a database or search platform, so the story applies to Chroma. However, the evidence pack documents no user-definable rules, triggers, change streams or event-driven actions. Automatic embedding and indexing on insert is built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule that triggers actions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
